channel.title: Khoa Tran Engineering Portfolio - research
channel.description: research articles from Khoa Tran Engineering Portfolio.

item.title: ADR: Firestore vs PostgreSQL for Event Sourcing in Core Banking
item.description: An Architecture Decision Record detailing why Firestore was chosen over PostgreSQL as the primary EventStore for the Event-Driven Core Banking platform.

item.title: ADR: Choosing a GraphQL Gateway Over REST for Aegis
item.description: An Architecture Decision Record detailing why Aegis uses a GraphQL API Gateway to aggregate internal gRPC microservices instead of a traditional REST API.

item.title: Sub-300ms Store Discovery: Designing Geo-Search with Algolia
item.description: How we leveraged Algolia to build a blazing fast, geo-aware store discovery engine for SeensioGO and Jujuja, achieving 150-300ms latency.

item.title: Distributed Tracing with OpenTelemetry and Jaeger
item.description: A practical guide to instrumenting Go microservices with OpenTelemetry: from SDK setup to trace context propagation, sampling strategies, and reading Jaeger flame graphs.

item.title: Event Sourcing vs CRUD: When to Choose Each
item.description: A decision framework for choosing between Event Sourcing and traditional CRUD, based on building both a CRUD loyalty API and a full event-sourced core banking system.

item.title: Order Book Imbalance (OBI) as a Signal for Short-Term Price Prediction
item.description: Research notes on extracting Order Book Imbalance (OBI) features from Level-3 market data (VN30F2112) to train rolling-window ML classifiers for High-Frequency Trading.

item.title: Designing a Permission System: Beyond Simple Roles
item.description: How to evolve from brittle role checks to a maintainable, high-performance policy-based authorization engine.

item.title: Scaling Background Jobs: Adaptive Concurrency
item.description: Operational patterns and practical lessons for scaling asynchronous jobs while keeping failure rates and costs predictable.
